regression_gate.requirement: M0 suites stay green after the workspace conversion and M1 changes
regression_gate.evidence: Full sequential run after review fixes (2026-09-14): M0 unit 53/53, M0 integration 43/43, baseline 6/6

suite_results.unit_all: PASS 123/123 (53 M0 + 70 M1: platform-config, storefront-contracts, local-deploy/gateway, gateway-hardening, harness)
suite_results.e2e_m1: PASS 4/4 (local provider, 4 real next build static exports, preview gateway)

tests.requirement: Creation produces StoreEnvironment, owned sales channel/publishable key/stock location, pinned StorefrontProject, owner membership and a ready preview deployment
A failure after commerce resources exist compensates everything (no environment, channel, key, location, ownership, project or deployment left)
tests.evidence: First run left the publishable key behind: Medusa's createApiKeysStep compensation cannot delete unrevoked keys. Fixed with a revoke-then-delete step

tests.requirement: Invalid, reserved and duplicate handles, an empty name, and tenant selectors in the body are rejected before creation; merchants cannot create environments
Each preview URL renders only its own environment's store name and products
tests.evidence: m1-preview-e2e.spec.ts M1-T02: maria-candles/petya-jewellery .preview.localhost each render only their own store name and product (real builds, gateway, x-platform-deployment matches)

tests.requirement: Merchants can only redeploy their own preview, with no parameters (environment/project/key/target selectors rejected; operator route forbidden)
The storefront typed tool cannot target another environment
Redeploy fails closed, without running the provider, for a foreign key, a key corrupted with another environment's channel, config injection, or an unavailable core version
Deployment rows whose hostname or environment disagree with the project are refused by the manifest builder
The manifest carries exactly this environment's publishable key and no tenant id or other store data
tests.evidence: M1-T04 (dry-run manifest); M1-T04e E2E artifact scan: no foreign publishable key and no backend secrets in any build file, own key present

tests.requirement: The local build child environment passes only allow-listed OS variables and never backend secrets
Preview hosts resolve only their own ready deployment; live, look-alike, unknown and suspended hosts do not
tests.evidence: M1-T05 (integration), platform-config.unit.spec.ts; E2E M1-T05e (live/look-alike/unknown hosts 404 at gateway) and M1-T05f (suspension stops preview immediately)

tests.requirement: storefront-schema rejects invalid or extended config; manifest rejects extra keys, multiple keys, non-publishable keys and an unavailable core version; the core version is pinned per project
No shared multi-tenant storefront runtime: per-deployment artifacts, one environment per hostname, the gateway serves static artifacts only, the harness takes exactly one manifest
tests.evidence: M1-T07 (integration: unique artifacts, one environment per hostname), local-deploy.unit.spec.ts gateway suite (host routing, traversal, 404/405), harness.unit.spec.ts (harness exits 2 without exactly one manifest)

tests.requirement: The preview gateway has a runnable entry point that serves ready deployments resolved from the database on the port used in preview URLs
tests.evidence: Review round 1 MATERIAL_ISSUE (only tests started a gateway). Fixed: startPreviewGateway + src/scripts/preview-gateway.ts + `npm run preview:gateway`; integration M1-R1 serves Maria's ready deployment via startPreviewGateway and 404s Petya/live hosts; gateway-hardening.unit.spec.ts checks the script, npm script and port

tests.requirement: Hostname collisions and concurrent same-handle creation leave no orphan organization or duplicate bindings
tests.evidence: Review N1 (orphan Organization). Fixed: organization is its own compensating step; validation checks live/preview hostname uniqueness. Integration M1-N1 (collision + 3 concurrent creates: exactly one environment, org, channel, key)

tests.requirement: The gateway never follows symlinks/junctions out of an artifact or serves an artifact directory resolving outside the deploy root
tests.evidence: Review N2. Fixed: real-path containment. gateway-hardening.unit.spec.ts (junction inside artifact and junction artifact_ref both 404)

tests.requirement: An older deployment finishing after a newer one never replaces it; exactly one ready deployment per project/target
tests.evidence: Review N3. Fixed: mark ready, then keep only the newest ready (time-ordered ids); resolver picks newest. Integration M1-N3

tests.requirement: Revoking a project's publishable key stops its preview being served
tests.evidence: Review N4. Fixed in resolvePreviewRoute. Integration M1-N4

tests.requirement: Merchants see only a generic deployment error; raw build/manifest detail and backend URLs stay operator-side
tests.evidence: Review N5. Fixed in merchant-storefront.ts. Integration M1-N5

independent_review.round_1: MATERIAL_ISSUE at 3cad636: M1-R1 preview gateway had no runnable entry point (preview URLs were dead outside tests); minor N1-N5. Suites reproduced 119/56/4/6.
independent_review.fixes: startPreviewGateway + `npm run preview:gateway` (R1); organization rollback step and hostname uniqueness validation (N1); real-path containment in gateway (N2); newest ready deployment wins (N3); revoked publishable key stops preview (N4); generic merchant deployment error (N5)
